correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact face cover X0=Δ(A∪B)∪Δ(A∪C)∪Δ(B∪C) plus p defect simplices Pi, q defect simplices Qj and pq tetrahedra Tij, using that each middle-shore vertex can appear only as one matched endpoint and the two defect families are disjoint. X0 has three-set circular nerve and is S1. Each Pi and Qj is contractible and attaches along a genuine S1 generator, producing pair relative H2=Z^(p+q) mapping by (1,...,1) to H1(X0)=Z, and killing π1. Each Tij intersects assembled Y in its entire 2-sphere boundary. Its oriented attaching class is e_i-f_j in H2(Y) and the pq classes span the primitive sum-zero lattice: an incidence spanning-tree minor of K_{p,q} has determinant ±1. The long exact sequence gives H3 free rank pq-p-q+1=(p-1)(q-1), all other reduced integral groups zero. Van Kampen, Hurewicz and homological Whitehead establish the full wedge homotopy. Independently recomputed forbidden triangles, exact full face-cover equality and mod-two reduced Betti in four examples, including p=1,q=1, p=q=2 and p=3,q=2; integral incidence argument, not small examples, proves all-size theorem.
residual_risks: All-size proof requires defects be disjoint within B; overlapping middle endpoints may create different simplex types.
The nine/four finite examples verify only those parameters, while primitive incidence and cofibration topology prove the quantified statement.
